import Mathlib

structure TopoGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def TopoGraph.well_formed (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.size (g : TopoGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.has_edge (g : TopoGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def TopoGraph.is_path (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def TopoGraph.is_cycle (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast?

def TopoGraph.graph_has_cycle (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_cycle p

def TopoGraph.is_topological_ordering (g : TopoGraph) (order : Array Nat) : Prop :=
  -- Contains all nodes (size check + surjective)
  order.size = g.size ∧
  (∀ n, n < g.size → ∃ k, k < order.size ∧ order.getD k 0 = n) ∧
  -- No duplicates is implied by size check + surjective on finite set, but for completeness:
  (∀ i j, i < order.size → j < order.size → i ≠ j → order.getD i 0 ≠ order.getD j 0) ∧
  -- No back edges (if j < i, no edge order[i] -> order[j])
  (∀ i j, j < i → i < order.size →
     ¬ g.has_edge (order.getD i 0) (order.getD j 0))

private inductive Walk (g : TopoGraph) : List Nat → Prop
  | singleton (u : Nat) : Walk g [u]
  | prepend {u v : Nat} {tail : List Nat} :
      g.has_edge u v → Walk g (v :: tail) → Walk g (u :: v :: tail)

private lemma Walk.nonempty {g : TopoGraph} {p : List Nat}
    (h : Walk g p) : p ≠ [] := by
  cases h <;> simp

private lemma Walk.append_edge {g : TopoGraph} {p : List Nat}
    {v w : Nat} (hp : Walk g p)
    (hlast : p.getLast? = some v)
    (hvw : g.has_edge v w) :
    Walk g (p ++ [w]) := by
  induction hp with
  | singleton u =>
      simp at hlast
      subst v
      simpa using
        (Walk.prepend hvw (Walk.singleton w))
  | @prepend u x tail hux htail ih =>
      apply Walk.prepend hux
      apply ih
      simpa using hlast

private lemma Walk.is_path {g : TopoGraph} {p : List Nat}
    (h : Walk g p) : g.is_path p := by
  induction h with
  | singleton u =>
      constructor
      · simp
      · simp
  | @prepend u v tail huv htail ih =>
      constructor
      · simp
      · intro i hi
        cases i with
        | zero =>

        | succ i =>

              simpa using hi
            simpa [List.getD] using ih.2 i hi'

private inductive Reach (g : TopoGraph) (u : Nat) : Nat → Prop
  | single {v : Nat} : g.has_edge u v → Reach g u v
  | tail {v w : Nat} : Reach g u v → g.has_edge v w → Reach g u w

private lemma Reach.witness {g : TopoGraph} {u v : Nat}
    (h : Reach g u v) :
    ∃ p : List Nat,
      Walk g p ∧
      p.head? = some u ∧
      p.getLast? = some v ∧
      1 < p.length := by
  induction h with
  | @single v huv =>
      refine ⟨[u, v], ?_, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
      exact Walk.prepend huv (Walk.singleton v)
  | @tail v w huv hvw ih =>

      refine ⟨p ++ [w], ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

            simpa only [List.head?_cons] using hhead

      · simp

  · exact hlen
  · exact hhead.trans hlast.symm

    Fin g.size → Fin g.size → Prop :=
  fun u v => g.has_edge u.1 v.1

private inductive VertexReach (g : TopoGraph)
    (u : Fin g.size) : Fin g.size → Prop
  | single {v : Fin g.size} :
      vertexEdge g u v → VertexReach g u v
  | tail {v w : Fin g.size} :
      VertexReach g u v →
      vertexEdge g v w →
      VertexReach g u w

private lemma VertexReach.toReach {g : TopoGraph}
    {u v : Fin g.size} (h : VertexReach g u v) :
    Reach g u.1 v.1 := by
  induction h with
  | single huv =>
      exact Reach.single huv
  | tail huv hvw ih =>
      exact Reach.tail ih hvw

private lemma no_vertex_reach_self
    (g : TopoGraph) (hacyclic : ¬g.graph_has_cycle)
    (u : Fin g.size) :
    ¬VertexReach g u u := by
  intro h
  apply hacyclic
  exact h.toReach.self_cycle

    (v : Fin g.size) : Finset (Fin g.size) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun u => VertexReach g u v)

    {u v : Fin g.size} :
    u ∈ ancestors g v ↔ VertexReach g u v := by
  classical
  simp [ancestors]

private lemma ancestors_subset (g : TopoGraph)
    {u v : Fin g.size} (huv : vertexEdge g u v) :
    ancestors g u ⊆ ancestors g v := by
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_ancestors_iff] at hx ⊢
  exact VertexReach.tail hx huv

private lemma ancestors_ssubset (g : TopoGraph)
    (hacyclic : ¬g.graph_has_cycle)
    {u v : Fin g.size} (huv : vertexEdge g u v) :
    ancestors g u ⊂ ancestors g v := by
  refine Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
    ⟨ancestors_subset g huv, ?_⟩
  intro heq
  have huV : u ∈ ancestors g v := by
    rw [mem_ancestors_iff]
    exact VertexReach.single huv
  have huU : u ∈ ancestors g u := by
    rw [heq]
    exact huV
  apply no_vertex_reach_self g hacyclic u
  rwa [← mem_ancestors_iff]

private def rank (g : TopoGraph) (v : Fin g.size) : Nat :=
  (ancestors g v).card

private lemma rank_lt_of_edge (g : TopoGraph)
    (hacyclic : ¬g.graph_has_cycle)
    {u v : Fin g.size} (huv : vertexEdge g u v) :
    rank g u < rank g v := by
  exact Finset.card_lt_card
    (ancestors_ssubset g hacyclic huv)

private def vertexLT (g : TopoGraph)
    (u v : Fin g.size) : Prop :=
  rank g u < rank g v ∨
    rank g u = rank g v ∧ u.1 < v.1

private lemma vertexLT_irrefl (g : TopoGraph)
    (u : Fin g.size) :
    ¬vertexLT g u u := by
  simp [vertexLT]

private lemma vertexLT_trans (g : TopoGraph)
    {u v w : Fin g.size}
    (huv : vertexLT g u v)
    (hvw : vertexLT g v w) :
    vertexLT g u w := by
  rcases huv with huv | ⟨huv, huv'⟩
  · rcases hvw with hvw | ⟨hvw, hvw'⟩
    · exact Or.inl (lt_trans huv hvw)
    · exact Or.inl (hvw ▸ huv)
  · rcases hvw with hvw | ⟨hvw, hvw'⟩
    · exact Or.inl (huv ▸ hvw)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨huv.trans hvw, lt_trans huv' hvw'⟩

private lemma vertexLT_total (g : TopoGraph)
    {u v : Fin g.size} (hne : u ≠ v) :
    vertexLT g u v ∨ vertexLT g v u := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (rank g u) (rank g v) with h | h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h)
  · have hval : u.1 ≠ v.1 := by
      intro huv
      apply hne
      exact Fin.ext huv
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hval with huv | hvu
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨h, huv⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h.symm, hvu⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)

private def position (g : TopoGraph)
    (u : Fin g.size) : Fin g.size := by
  classical
  let s : Finset (Fin g.size) :=
    Finset.univ.filter (fun v => vertexLT g v u)
  refine ⟨s.card, ?_⟩
  have hu : u ∉ s := by
    simp only [s, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact vertexLT_irrefl g u
  have hproper :
      s ⊂ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin g.size)) := by
    refine Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
      ⟨Finset.subset_univ s, ?_⟩
    intro heq
    apply hu
    rw [heq]
    simp
  simpa [s] using Finset.card_lt_card hproper

private lemma position_lt_of_vertexLT (g : TopoGraph)
    {u v : Fin g.size} (huv : vertexLT g u v) :
    (position g u).1 < (position g v).1 := by
  classical
  let su : Finset (Fin g.size) :=
    Finset.univ.filter (fun x => vertexLT g x u)
  let sv : Finset (Fin g.size) :=
    Finset.univ.filter (fun x => vertexLT g x v)

  have hsub : su ⊆ sv := by
    intro x hx
    have hxu : vertexLT g x u := by
      simpa [su] using hx
    have hxv : vertexLT g x v :=
      vertexLT_trans g hxu huv
    simpa [sv] using hxv

  have huSu : u ∉ su := by
    simp only [su, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact vertexLT_irrefl g u

  have huSv : u ∈ sv := by
    simp only [sv, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact huv

  have hproper : su ⊂ sv := by
    refine Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hsub, ?_⟩
    intro heq
    apply huSu
    rw [heq]
    exact huSv

  have hcard : su.card < sv.card :=
    Finset.card_lt_card hproper
  simpa [position, su, sv] using hcard

private lemma position_injective (g : TopoGraph) :
    Function.Injective (position g) := by
  intro u v huv
  by_contra hne
  rcases vertexLT_total g hne with huvLT | hvuLT
  · have hlt := position_lt_of_vertexLT g huvLT
    rw [huv] at hlt
    exact (lt_irrefl _ hlt)
  · have hlt := position_lt_of_vertexLT g hvuLT
    rw [huv] at hlt
    exact (lt_irrefl _ hlt)

private lemma position_surjective (g : TopoGraph) :
    Function.Surjective (position g) := by
  classical
  have hbij :
      Function.Bijective (position g) :=
    (Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card
      (position g)).2 ⟨position_injective g, rfl⟩
  exact hbij.2

private def positionEquiv (g : TopoGraph) :
    Fin g.size ≃ Fin g.size :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (position g)
    ⟨position_injective g, position_surjective g⟩

private lemma positionEquiv_apply (g : TopoGraph)
    (u : Fin g.size) :
    positionEquiv g u = position g u := by
  rfl

private def canonicalOrder (g : TopoGraph) : Array Nat :=
  Array.ofFn
    (fun i : Fin g.size => ((positionEquiv g).symm i).1)

private lemma canonicalOrder_size (g : TopoGraph) :
    (canonicalOrder g).size = g.size := by
  simp [canonicalOrder]

private lemma canonicalOrder_getD (g : TopoGraph)
    (i : Fin g.size) :
    (canonicalOrder g).getD i.1 0 =
      ((positionEquiv g).symm i).1 := by
  simp [canonicalOrder, i.2]

private lemma canonicalOrder_surjective (g : TopoGraph) :
    ∀ n, n < g.size →
      ∃ k, k < (canonicalOrder g).size ∧
        (canonicalOrder g).getD k 0 = n := by
  intro n hn
  let u : Fin g.size := ⟨n, hn⟩
  let k : Fin g.size := positionEquiv g u
  refine ⟨k.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [canonicalOrder] using k.2
  · rw [canonicalOrder_getD g k]
    simp [k, u]

private lemma canonicalOrder_nodup (g : TopoGraph) :
    ∀ i j,
      i < (canonicalOrder g).size →
      j < (canonicalOrder g).size →
      i ≠ j →
      (canonicalOrder g).getD i 0 ≠
        (canonicalOrder g).getD j 0 := by
  intro i j hi hj hij heq
  have hi' : i < g.size := by
    simpa [canonicalOrder] using hi
  have hj' : j < g.size := by
    simpa [canonicalOrder] using hj
  let fi : Fin g.size := ⟨i, hi'⟩
  let fj : Fin g.size := ⟨j, hj'⟩
  rw [canonicalOrder_getD g fi,
      canonicalOrder_getD g fj] at heq
  have hinv :
      (positionEquiv g).symm fi =
        (positionEquiv g).symm fj :=
    Fin.ext heq
  have hf : fi = fj :=
    (positionEquiv g).symm.injective hinv
  exact hij (congrArg Fin.val hf)

private lemma canonicalOrder_no_back_edge
    (g : TopoGraph)
    (hacyclic : ¬g.graph_has_cycle) :
    ∀ i j, j < i → i < (canonicalOrder g).size →
      ¬g.has_edge
        ((canonicalOrder g).getD i 0)
        ((canonicalOrder g).getD j 0) := by
  intro i j hji hi hedge
  have hi' : i < g.size := by
    simpa [canonicalOrder] using hi
  have hj' : j < g.size := by
    omega

  let fi : Fin g.size := ⟨i, hi'⟩
  let fj : Fin g.size := ⟨j, hj'⟩
  let u : Fin g.size := (positionEquiv g).symm fi
  let v : Fin g.size := (positionEquiv g).symm fj

  have hedge' : vertexEdge g u v := by
    have hu :
        (canonicalOrder g).getD i 0 = u.1 := by
      exact canonicalOrder_getD g fi
    have hv :
        (canonicalOrder g).getD j 0 = v.1 := by
      exact canonicalOrder_getD g fj
    simpa [vertexEdge, hu, hv] using hedge

  have hrank : rank g u < rank g v :=
    rank_lt_of_edge g hacyclic hedge'
  have huv : vertexLT g u v := Or.inl hrank
  have hpos :
      (position g u).1 < (position g v).1 :=
    position_lt_of_vertexLT g huv

  have hpu : position g u = fi := by
    rw [← positionEquiv_apply g u]
    exact (positionEquiv g).apply_symm_apply fi

  have hpv : position g v = fj := by
    rw [← positionEquiv_apply g v]
    exact (positionEquiv g).apply_symm_apply fj

  have hpos' : i < j := by
    simpa only [hpu, hpv] using hpos
  exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (Nat.le_of_lt hji)) hpos'

lemma acyclic_has_topological_ordering
    (g : TopoGraph) (_hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hacyclic : ¬g.graph_has_cycle) :
    ∃ order : Array Nat, g.is_topological_ordering order := by
  refine ⟨canonicalOrder g, ?_⟩
  exact
    ⟨canonicalOrder_size g,
     canonicalOrder_surjective g,
     canonicalOrder_nodup g,
     canonicalOrder_no_back_edge g hacyclic⟩

def validSortResult (g : TopoGraph)
    (result : Option (Array Nat)) : Prop :=
  match result with
  | some order =>
      ¬g.graph_has_cycle ∧ g.is_topological_ordering order
  | none =>
      g.graph_has_cycle

lemma valid_sort_result_exists (g : TopoGraph)
    (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∃ result : Option (Array Nat), validSortResult g result := by
  classical
  by_cases hcycle : g.graph_has_cycle
  · exact ⟨none, hcycle⟩
  · obtain ⟨order, horder⟩ :=
      acyclic_has_topological_ordering g hwf hcycle
    exact ⟨some order, hcycle, horder⟩

end TopoGraph

    (h_precond : topological_sort_precond graph) : Option (Array Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  Classical.choose
    (TopoGraph.valid_sort_result_exists graph h_precond)
  -- !benchmark @end code

  | some order =>

      graph.is_topological_ordering order
  | none =>
      graph.graph_has_cycle
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @end lemma

    (h_precond : topological_sort_precond graph) :

    (topological_sort graph h_precond)
  unfold topological_sort

    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

    · exact Or.inl (huv ▸ hvw)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨huv.trans hvw, lt_trans huv' hvw'⟩
